findingDetails.title: The hooks README gate inventory omits the new blocking gate
findingDetails.claim: The README says pre-commit runs ten blocking sub-gates and lists ten; the private-skill guard runs as an eleventh blocking gate with no bypass and is not named.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked lib/gates.tsv and both manual-testing playbooks for the gate; it is correctly absent from gates.tsv (no configurable key) and absent from the playbooks.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The inventory may be scoped to gates with a bypass or a config row; the private-skill gate has neither, but the total sentence does not say so.

findingDetails.title: The parent related-documents pointer names a field that does not exist
findingDetails.claim: spec.md:223 points readers to graph-metadata.json derived.last_active_child_id, a key the parent metadata file does not contain.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the whole parent metadata file and the children for the key; no match.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The field belonged to an older metadata schema and the pointer text outlived it.
